content.expected_result: Historical b1 renders identical SVG to its original content and its original source pins remain intact.
preconditions: Publish an original current board with exact child content pins, save its SVG and content digest, and commit the Saga to a real Git repository.

steps.action: Edit the child ERD definition without changing the board source pins, then reload the saved board.
steps.expected_result: The board retains its exact child pin and never follows newer content implicitly.

steps.action: Publish updated current board content, then resolve the original board by its saved content digest from Git.
steps.expected_result: The saved original SVG and exact child pins are reproduced. Missing Git objects remain unresolved; no Saga history sidecar or current-content substitution is used.

content.title: Reopen an exact historical board after newer publication
